gates.requirement: Invalid substrates, footprint contracts, effect estimands, thresholds, capacities, cardinalities, penalties, ambiguity rules, or budgets fail with invalid_comparison_spec and no comparison status.
Expected-energy footprints normalize to unit integral and have symmetric point coverage; probability footprints remain unnormalized and may be asymmetric.
Coverage and effect intervals decide eligibility and conclusive failure; point estimates rank only already eligible edges.
Invalid projection, target-address absence, and fidelity or consequentiality failure resolve as incomparable, omission, and loss in that precedence order.
Coverage failure, effect incompatibility, and unique unmatched outcomes are resolved null relations rather than indeterminate or omission.
Zero footprint, boundary crossing, incomplete evidence, unavailable capability, ambiguity, and budget exhaustion remain indeterminate.

The exact matcher and independently recomputed certificate encode both unmatched-indicator directions and honor capacities, cardinalities, maximum n, lambda, objective tolerance, and cardinality preference.
Structural ambiguity is evaluated before lexicographic replay, whose representative remains diagnostic only.
Resolved 1:1, 1:n, and n:1 components emit overlap, split, and merge; many-to-many ambiguity is never forced into a relation.
Every source and target unit receives a persisted relation outcome, canonical reason, exact contracts, solution evidence, and receipt.
Native addresses, representation IDs, metrics, and semantic identities remain separate from cross-arm relation evidence.
Mock alternate-arm, source, reconstruction, residual, and disagreement fixtures remain known-parameter conformance data rather than empirical evidence.
A relation-method defect appends canonical invalidation evidence and queues descendant review without rewriting frozen relation bytes.
